    grid_w = obs.get("grid_width", 0)
    grid_h = obs.get("grid_height", 0)
    me = obs.get("self_position", [0, 0])
    op = obs.get("opponent_position", [0, 0])

    # 1) move toward closest resource if available
    if resources:
        best = None
        bestd = 10**9
        for r in resources:

            if d < bestd:
                bestd = d
                best = (rx, ry)
        if best is not None:
            rx, ry = best
            dx = 1 if rx > mx else (-1 if rx < mx else 0)
            dy = 1 if ry > my else (-1 if ry < my else 0)
            return [dx, dy]

    # 2) simple avoid of opponent: step away if adjacent or closer

            dx = 1 if ox > mx else -1
        else:
            dx = -1 if ox > mx else 1
            dy = -1 if oy > my else 1
        return [dx, dy]

    # 3) move toward open space away from obstacles/opponent
    nx, ny = mx, my
    if ox > mx:
        nx = mx + 1
    elif ox < mx:
        nx = mx - 1
    if oy > my:
        ny = my + 1
    elif oy < my:
        ny = my - 1
    cand = (nx, ny)
    if cand[0] < 0: cand = (0, cand[1])
    if cand[0] >= grid_w: cand = (grid_w - 1, cand[1])
    if cand[1] < 0: cand = (cand[0], 0)
